posts.author: JohnDoeGames
posts.body:
Welcome!
And... Yeah, hobbies cost money, but it doesn't have to cost much. MV is often on sale, and if you're lucky you can get it for $10, sometimes even cheaper. Summer sale on Steam is always a big one, so keep your eyes on the steam store, as soon as you see "summer sale", you search doe RPG maker, and you'll see MV and even MZ are very affordable, even for kids with a little allowance as main income.
I've checked, and it is actually on sale right now. You can download MV for a little over 11 euro's, I think that is about $10? You've got $10, right?
WHat I try to say is: Right now, it 85% off, so it costs a lot less money than it normally does.
